sources.notes: Served in 2°×2° crops by the MARS OS backend (HTTP Range reads of the PDS files; the PDS does not allow direct browser access). Coverage 88°S–88°N. Many 128 ppd cells are interpolated between MOLA tracks: 463 m is a grid spacing, not a guaranteed resolution.

sources.title: Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region, Mars
sources.agency: U.S. Geological Survey Astrogeology Science Center
sources.citation: Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M., 2020, Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map 3464, scale 1:75,000. https://doi.org/10.3133/sim3464.
sources.license: U.S. Geological Survey public data; review source terms and attribution
sources.notes: Official GIS database ZIP is about 349.3 MB. Map covers 1°×1° (~60×60 km), 76.8°–77.8°E and 17.7°–18.7°N; base map is a CTX mosaic at 6 m/pixel. Geologic interpretations are regional-scale at publication scale 1:75,000. USGS notes random offsets of roughly 100–200 m relative to the later controlled CTX mosaic used for surface operations. Do not render as a pixel-accurate overlay until reprojected and alignment is checked.

sources.title: Mars2020 Observational Product - best_interp.csv
sources.agency: NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node
sources.citation: NASA Planetary Data System, Mars 2020 Rover PLACES Bundle, Release 16, data_localizations/best_interp.csv; accessed 2026-11-14.
sources.notes: PDS4 product label identifies this exact product and version 16.0. Positions are rover localizations; planetocentric latitude and east-positive longitude in degrees, elevation in meters relative to product datum. The generated GeoJSON contains only ROVER rows, grouped by sol and ordered by SCLK; 33,370 position records across 523 sols, 14–1897, reduced to per-sol polylines. It is a historical rover track, not a recommended human route. Release 16 omits ROVER,n,0 rows from best_interp.csv; use SITE,n for position and telemetry.csv for orientation where required. Release notes show an inconsistent start-year text (2022) while the product label and bundle landing page say 2021; catalog uses the product-label timestamps.

description.en: Ancient lake basin with a preserved delta, explored by Perseverance since 2021. Center from the IAU nomenclature index; bbox from the Mars Trek Perseverance bookmark. Includes a 20 m/pixel CTX elevation mosaic for regional relief; it does not resolve small obstacles.
description.es: Antigua cuenca lacustre con un delta preservado, explorada por Perseverance desde 2021. Centro según el índice de nomenclatura de la IAU; caja según el marcador de Perseverance en Mars Trek. Incluye un mosaico de elevación CTX de 20 m/píxel para relieve regional; no resuelve obstáculos pequeños.
